svg.title: Stereo check of the 12 rebuilt tails
svg.desc: For each of the 12 truncated tails of the minimal example: C8 and C13 configuration, C2=C3 geometry and the worst tail bond angle, as tleap placed them (5 of 12 pass), in the v0.1.0 reference output (it rebuilt only CHL 663, CLA 669 and CHL 719, and all three fail) and in the v0.2.0 reference output (12 of 12 pass).

g.aria-label: fails: S centre, C2=C3 not E, or a tail bond angle more than 20° from natural phytyl. angle = the one furthest from it.
– : v0.1.0 rebuilt only the three tails listed in its own leap.log and left the others as tleap placed them.
CHL 440 and CHL 666: C8 is already S in the deposited model; v0.2.0 rebuilds it with --fix-resolved-stereo.
